findings.summary: closeMenu() removes the keydown listener but never calls document.removeEventListener('click', onClickOutside), even though openMenu() registers it on every open. The brief explicitly requires this cleanup ('including cleaning up any listeners added for the outside-click detection once the menu is closed, so they don't keep firing after the menu is dismissed'). Consequence is worse than a leak: after the menu is opened and closed once, onClickOutside stays live on document forever. Every subsequent click anywhere on the page that isn't inside toggleEl/menuEl re-runs closeMenu(), and closeMenu() unconditionally calls toggleEl.focus() — so the hamburger button steals keyboard focus on every click across the whole site after the first menu interaction.

findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff contains zero test files, the repo has no test runner configured (no vitest/playwright/jest in package.json), and no test infrastructure exists anywhere in the tree. The claim is unverifiable and appears false.
